articles.headline: If You Invested $100 In Welltower Stock 20 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
articles.summary: Welltower (NYSE:WELL) has outperformed the market over the past 20 years by 3.33% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 12.57%. Currently, Welltower has a market capitalization of $172.74 billion.
